svg.title: Building Payment Modules on Top of Payment Component (Event-Driven Architecture - How It Works)

g.text: Building Payment Modules on Top of Payment Component
Built Once - Reusable for All Providers
Adding a New Provider (e.g., Amazon Pay):
User enters: card number, CVV, email, phone
✅ Sensitive data never visible in network tab
✅ Browser never stores plain text data
🔒 Card data never in plain text on frontend
Multiple requests to same resource waste time
